name: The Militia's Birthright

perks.name: Volatile Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon is optimized for an especially explosive payload.
  •  Greatly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed
  •  Slightly decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Countermass
perks.desc:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Hard Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is optimized for projectile speed.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Linear Compensator
perks.desc:
This weapon's launch barrel is well-balanced.
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Quick Launch
perks.desc:
This weapon's barrel provides faster projectiles and much faster aiming.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Smart Drift Control
perks.desc:
This barrel is broadly optimized for firing control.
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases projectile speed

perks.name: Disorienting Grenades
perks.desc:
Detonation has a brief disorienting effect. 
  •  Greatly decreases blast radius

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Spike Grenades
perks.desc:
Grenades fired from this weapon do increased damage on direct hits.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Implosion Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon's projectiles travel faster and have a controlled explosion.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Decreases blast radius

perks.name: Concussion Grenades
perks.desc: Grenades fired from this weapon emit a blast that staggers enemies.

perks.name: Black Powder
perks.desc:
This weapon's explosives are more effective.
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Decreases stability

perks.name: Slideways
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.desc: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.desc: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Genesis
perks.desc: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.desc: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

perks.name: Danger Zone
perks.desc: The blast radius of this weapon increases when surrounded by combatants. While active, this weapon deals significantly less damage to the wielder.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Stunning Recovery
perks.desc: Stunning a Champion refills your magazine, triggers health regeneration, and improves recovery for a short duration.

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

perks.name: Field-Tested
perks.desc:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): Recommended MW: Reload. Lightweight(90) Kinetic Grenade Launcher Special Ammo. "Militia’s Birthright is a great re-re-return. Ambitious Assassin is best in slot but I do wish Auto-Loading Holster was in the third column instead of the fourth. Frenzy does give you 100 reload speed so you won’t have to invest in reload unless you don’t have Frenzy up. One for All is also another great shout as you can hit three enemies all at once for an instant damage increase."

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): Recommended MW: Velocity. Lightweight(90) Kinetic Grenade Launcher Special Ammo. "Slideshot and Auto-Loading Holster gives you two different ways to reload this weapon. You can slide to fire two shots near-instantly, or just stow your weapon for ALH to take over. It doesn’t have the benefit of Disruption Break or Chill Clip but it does have utility if you’re using your GL a lot, or double GLs."

[YeezyGT's S18] [MW: Velocity] "Militia's Birthright is back, and its milder than ever. It serves as a serviceable replacement for the Slideshot Ignition Code, though the cooldown on Slideways definitely hurts its efficacy. I'd only recommend Quickdraw/ALH, which serves as a fantastic Blinding/Spike option for utility or damage." tags:pve

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 34. PvE first-choice roll for minor add control in end-game content. Probably only necessary if you've not already got a Blinding Grenade roll on an Ignition Code or Pardon Our Dust. Handling and Velocity are what you need in your barrel, and Quick Launch delivers both. Blinding Grenades is always great for easier add control, particularly in crowds, and there's a case for both Quickdraw or Lead From Gold in your first trait column, paired with Auto-Loading Holster in the second so that you always have a shot ready. Recommended MW: Velocity or Handling - there's really nothing much a mod can add directly as you're not aiming for kills, so maybe Backup Mag mod's increase ammo reserves is the best option, but feel free to plug in what works for you.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 34. PvE first-choice roll for burst damage against Majors and stunned Champions in end-game content. Probably only necessary if you've not already got a good Spike Grenade roll on an Ignition Code or Pardon Our Dust. Handling and Velocity are what you need in your barrel, and Quick Launch delivers both. Spike Grenades adds damage for direct hits, and there's a case for both Slideways for reloading and a Handling boost, or Ambitious Assassin to improve damage output in your first trait column, and Frenzy or One For All in the second. Recommended MW: Velocity or Handling, with a damage-boosting (Major or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE Controller \ M+KB): Recommended MW: Reload “I am so very glad Militia's Birthright is back. Mostly for my friend u/The_SpellJammer. Militia's Birthright has not really seen too many changes from its former self. Ambitious and auto-loading are funny together, but unfortunately do not proc one another. Lead from gold is another fantastic perk when paired with a full lead from gold build. Frenzy is the top choice for the final column. Having two grenades with the 15% damage increase, 50 handling, and the most important part being the 50 reload. The reload alone will max out your reload stat making it easier to reload into ambitious assassin.“ (Year 5 S18: Season of Plunder Kinetic Grenade Launcher Special Ammo)

pandapaxxy (PvP Controller): Recommended MW: Handling “In PvP there are better options. Truthteller outclasses Militia's Birthright and Salvager's Salvo feels like you are shooting rockets. Militia's can work, but it will have a large uphill battle.“ (Year 5 S18: Season of Plunder Kinetic Grenade Launcher Special Ammo)
